title: eleutherococcus cissifolius var. scandens
intro: Eleutherococcus cissifolius var. scandens, commonly known as the Chinese burnet, is a plant species in the family Saxifragaceae. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Chinese burnet include antioxidant and antipyretic properties, which contribute to its use in treating fever and other inflammatory conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
